title: Consistent Modified Gravity Weak Lensing in Energy-Flow Cosmology: The µ–Σ Eigenmode, Destructive Interference, and E_G as the Orthogonal Probe
description: Derives the observable eigenstructure of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) for weak lensing in a consistent modified-gravity setup (Case B) where µ(k,z) affects growth and Σ(k,z) affects the lensing kernel. Shows analytically that weak lensing constrains only a single effective parameter η_eff = γ(µ−1) + (Σ−1), with growth suppression cancelling 66% of the lensing boost. Proves that E_G measures Σ/µ^γ and is orthogonal to weak lensing, predicting E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086.

modified_poisson_phi.description: Modified Poisson equation for the Newtonian potential that controls structure growth.

modified_poisson_weyl.description: Modified Poisson equation for the Weyl potential that sources lensing.

gravitational_slip.description: Gravitational slip relation implied by the modified Poisson equations.

wl_ratio.description: Leading-order response of cosmic shear power to EFC modifications with growth index \gamma \approx 0.55.

eta_eff.description: Single effective parameter visible to weak lensing at the EFC anchor.

eta_deg.description: Degenerate (invisible) direction to weak lensing; along this line C_\ell^{\mathrm{EFC}} = C_\ell^{\mathrm{GR}} to leading order.

growth_index.description: Approximate parametrization of the growth factor under small deviations from GR.

eg_ratio.description: EG statistic is orthogonal to the weak-lensing product eigenmode; in GR, E_G = \Omega_m/f.

cancellation_ratio.description: Quantifies destructive interference: growth suppression cancels 66% of lensing amplification at the anchor.

bridge_Rka.description: EFC bridge strength controlling scale and density dependence; ensures GR recovery at high density and small scales.

key_results.main_finding: Weak lensing constrains only η_eff = γ(µ−1) + (Σ−1), leading to destructive interference where µ<1 cancels 66% of the Σ>1 lensing boost; EG is the orthogonal probe predicting E_G^EFC/E_G^GR = 1.086.
datasets_used: KiDS-1000 cosmic shear (planned WL-only Case B test)

sealed_predictions.statement: η_eff = 0.017 at the EFC anchor (k ≈ 0.05 h/Mpc, low z).
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Phase 1 weak-lensing-only minimisation (Case B) on KiDS-1000 scales.

sealed_predictions.statement: corr(µ0, Σ0) ∈ [−0.95, −0.80] in the WL-only posterior/eigenvector.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Phase 1 WL-only posterior/Fisher analysis in (µ0, Σ0).

sealed_predictions.statement: Δχ²(Case B, WL only vs GR) ∈ [−2, +2].
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Phase 1 WL-only goodness-of-fit comparison to GR on KiDS-1000.
KiDS × BOSS (or equivalent) EG measurement at k ≈ 0.05 h/Mpc, z ≲ 0.5.
Model-independent consistency given γ ≈ 0.55 and inferred (µ0, Σ0).

kill_criteria: KC1: Weak-lensing-only Case B analysis (KiDS-1000 scales, ℓ ≲ 100) yields η_eff inconsistent with 0.017 by >3σ at the EFC anchor.
KC2: The WL-only posterior correlation corr(µ0, Σ0) falls outside [−0.95, −0.80], indicating the predicted µ–Σ eigenmode is not realized.
KC3: A robust EG measurement finds E_G^EFC/E_G^GR inconsistent with 1.086 by >3σ at k ≈ 0.05 h/Mpc and z ≲ 0.5.
KC4: Case B WL-only fit prefers EFC over GR (or vice versa) with |Δχ²| > 6, contradicting the predicted near-null WL signal (−2 ≤ Δχ² ≤ +2).
KC5: The observed WL scale/redshift dependence contradicts the EFC localization (signal concentrated at ℓ ≲ 100 and ξ+(θ > 1°), with negligible effect in ξ− and at ℓ ≳ 200).

related_packages.role: Bridge calibration and validation for mapping (K0, m2) → (µ0, Σ0) and multi-scale consistency checks.
